options.description: NuGet source to use when checking / installing the  Kanject CLI.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a single JSON document on stdout instead of the  human-friendly Spectre output. Implies --yes (no prompts). Suitable for CI /  scripting.

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Skip the post-install verification (spawn-the-new-shim --version check). Use only if verification itself is broken — verification  is normally fast and confirms the new binary is live.

options.name: --paid
options.description: Include the paid template catalog (requires a Kanject  subscription feed) in the update even when it isn't installed yet. Without  this flag the paid pack is only checked when already installed; the bundled free templates are always kept fresh.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Provider whose template pack to update (e.g. aws,  azure, gcp). Defaults to aws. Each loaded provider plugin owns its own templates pack.

options.name: --template-source
options.description: NuGet source to use when checking / installing the  template pack.

options.name: --templates-only
options.description: Only update the template pack, skip the Kanject CLI  tool.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Apply updates without prompting.

commands.description: Check NuGet for newer Kanject CLI / template-pack versions and apply them.
